content.title: Christopher Meloni's 'Law & Order: Organized Crime' Canceled After 5 Seasons
content.text: Season 5 of the show, led by Christopher Meloni's Elliot Stabler, concluded in June 2025 Published on April 16, 2026 03:12PM EDT Christopher Meloni as Det. Elliot Stabler in 'Law & Order: Organized Crime'. Credit : Will Hart/NBC/NBCU Photo Bank/Getty NEED TO KNOW Law & Order: Organized Crime will not return for a sixth season, PEOPLE confirmsThe Christopher Meloni-led spinoff premiered in 2021 and saw Elliott Stabler return to New York and to the Organized Crime Control BureauSeason 5 concluded in June 2025 Law & Order: Organized Crime is over. The spinoff series led by Christopher Meloni will not return for a sixth season, PEOPLE confirms. The cancellation comes nearly a year after the most recent season of the show, season 5, concluded in June 2025. The actor, 65, reprised his beloved Law & Order: Special Victims Unit character, Elliot Stabler, in the spinoff series starting in 2021 and appeared in 75 episodes alongside Ainsley Seiger, Danielle Moné Truitt and Rick Gonazlez. The series saw Stabler return to New York "after a decade abroad to rebuild his life following a devastating personal loss," per the synopsis, as he worked with Sgt. Ayanna Bell’s (Truitt) in the Organized Crime Control Bureau. Deadline was the first to report the news. Mariska Hargitay as Captain Olivia Benson, Kelli Giddish as Detective Amanda Rollins, Christopher Meloni as Detective Elliot Stabler in 'Law & Order: Organized Crime'. Will Hart/NBC/Getty Meloni told PEOPLE last year that starring as Stabler is a "comfortable place" for him as he discussed the "best part" of the spinoff series. "It is a place I know very well, and yet I'm not tired of doing. It's good storytelling with people that I like to work with. When they asked me to do OC, I'd never had this feeling. It was a little bit like going home," he said. At the time, he said he didn't know what the show's fate was past season 5. "I don't know if there's going to be another [season]," he admitted. Related Stories Meloni originated the character on Law & Order: SVU in 1999, but departed the Mariska Hargitay-led series in 2012 after 12 seasons. "He was ready to go," Hargitay said on Call Her Daddy of her costar's decision to leave after 12 seasons together, noting she was "devastated" to lose him. "It happened very quickly, and it was surprising. It was over a negotiation. And I tried everything I could to fix it and change it,” she said. Christopher Meloni as Detective Elliot Stabler, Mariska Hargitay as Captain Olivia Benson in "Law & Order". Will Hart/NBC/Getty The fan-favorite pair have reunited onscreen dozens of times since then, starting with Stabler's return to the world of SVU in season 22 in 2021. Hargitay also appeared as Olivia Benson on Organized Crime numerous times. Law & Order: Organized Crime can be streamed on Peacock.
